mapper.select: SELECT s.screening_id, s.cinema_id, s.room_id, s.movie_id, s.screening_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, m.title, m.age_limit, m.running_time, m.director, m.content, r.room_name FROM screenings s JOIN movies m ON m.movie_id = s.movie_id JOIN rooms r ON r.room_id = s.room_id WHERE s.screening_id = #{screeningId}
